title: Get Trinity Working End to End
description: Get trinity working end to end. Plugin build fails: UiInspectorFieldGroup missing presence field in trinity/plugin/rs/lib.rs (jack + rewrite inspectors). Fix compile errors and verify trinity jack/rewrite apps run via framework OS playground.
summary: Trinity plugin failed to compile after UiInspectorFieldGroup gained required `presence` (unified UI element state model). Added `presence: UiPresence::default()` to the jack and rewrite identity inspector groups in trinity/plugin/rs/lib.rs. Verified: cargo release wasm build succeeds; SEMIO_RENDERER=react dev:trinity:jack serves http://127.0.0.1:6054/ with Nakagin Jack Query results; dev:trinity:rewrite serves http://127.0.0.1:6056/ with LHS/RHS/Jack/Parameters/Before/After chrome; Playwright confirms canvases and chrome for both.
